records.title: Inquiry of Accident on Mumbai Suburban Railway
details: a to e: A committee has been constituted to investigate the cause of incident near Mumbra Station on the Mumbai Suburban Railway network.

records.title: Changing Needs of Elderly People.
details:
a to c: A Committee on 'Strengthening the Care Economy in India' headed by Member, NITI Aayog, comprising representatives from the stakeholder Ministers, States/UTs,
academic institutions, senior are organizations and industry has been constituted to recommend a strategic framework for holistic care and welfare of the senior citizens.

records.title: Equitable Honorarium To Anganwadi Workers
details: (a) to (c): It has been announced in the interim budget FY 2024-25 to extend healthcare annual coverage of Rs. 5 Lakhs under Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) to all Anganwadi workers and helpers.

records.title: Disaffiliation and Downgrading Schools by CBSE
details: Part(a)&(b): The list of disaffiliated and downgraded schools by Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) in Maharashtra, Delhi and Rajasthan is enclosed at Annexure-A.
